newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks slip dragged by banks, Telefonica.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks slip dragged by banks, Telefonica.

text.p: MADRID, July 15 (Reuter) 0900 GMT - Madrid stocks were lower on Tuesday, dragged by some banks and Telefonica, and with a backdrop of a slightly weaker currency and bonds, dealers said.
Trading was mixed, with lower turnover than yesterday. The session was seen likely to be quiet.

* General index down 0.49 points, 0.08 pct, to 627.61 at open * Ibex sheds 31.80 points, 0.44 percent, to 7,137.02 * Telefonica off 45 pesetas to 4,480 amid press reports of an agressive pricing campaign by second basic operator Retevision. Traders said this simply served as an excuse for a retracement amid a lack of foreign client interest. * Banks see limited selling after first batch of six month results.
Popular was down 340 pesetas to 37,660 after first half results rose 4.2 percent, undershooting consensus forecasts for a 10.7 percent gain.
Although most banks took a breather, BBV continued to surge, adding 50 pesetas to 13,030 ahead of results which may show an up to 40 percent gain, according to some brokerages.
BBV releases results at the end of July.
